citation: Thorp, Robert L. 1991. “Erlitou and the Search for the Xia.” Early China 16: 1–38. DOI 10.1017/S0362502800003825. Published online by Cambridge University Press 26 March 2015.
notes: Peer-reviewed Early China article. Cambridge Core abstract (accessed 2026-10-11): places Xia-manifestation literature in context; analyzes published Erlitou typesite data (layout, architecture, burials, prestige crafts); proposes a “minimal” definition of the archaeological data that does not assume the historicity of the Xia. Use for Erlitou-as-archaeology framing and Xia-debate caution — not as proof of Xia dynasty.
